articles.title: Tether can freeze stolen crypto in minutes. Getting it back can take years.
articles.snippet: Tether says it has returned $1.28 billion in frozen USDT, but victims can wait years to recover their money and face fees of up to 20%.

articles.title: Monero suffers biggest single-day slide in over 5 months. Here’s why
articles.snippet: Monero (XMR) crashed over 11% on Thursday, its biggest drop since early June. Back-to-back exchange delistings seem to have catalyzed the price slide.

articles.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
articles.snippet: The vaults that would hold lenders' money are on track to switch on Dec. 9. The loan system that draws from them still needs one more validator to start its own two-week clock.

articles.title: Bitcoin supply metric hits 11-year low as new ‘capitulation’ signal arrives
articles.snippet: The seven-day moving average of Bitcoin’s supply profit/loss ratio hit an 11-year low as BTC price losses month-to-date remain near 20%.

articles.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
articles.snippet: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash’s privacy design sets it apart.
